caption: The drawing depicts a round plate or dish with a predominantly yellowish-brown background and a brown rim. Inside the circle, there is a symmetrical botanical design featuring a central stem from which several large, elongated, reddish-brown leaves or petals radiate outward. Around the central stem, there are additional floral elements, including two geometric, star-shaped flowers with checkered patterns in red and beige, and two circular, flower-like shapes with concentric rings and a central dot, in beige and red. Green wavy lines fill the space between the main plant elements, suggesting foliage or grass. Around the rim of the plate, there is an inscription written in a decorative, old-style script, in a dark color that contrasts with the lighter background. The entire composition is centered on a light beige background.
title: Pa. German Plate
